scope: post-view bridge diagnostic only; same already-consumed C073-A 20000 identities; no new confirmation evidence and no formal promotion
estimand: Does the already-confirmed C073-A conditional P(D|T,X) improve exact-score ranking when bridged to one frozen Direct-T baseline, conditional on T<=6?

direct_t_bridge.family: C071-B frozen baseline: median imputer + StandardScaler + multinomial LogisticRegression(C=0.1)
direct_t_bridge.test_usage: for score bridge only, renormalize P(T=0..6) conditional on T<=6; P(T>=7) is not disaggregated and therefore no unified exact-score matrix claim is allowed

conditional_d.baseline: C073-A league-specific alpha=1 empirical P(D|T) with pooled fallback
conditional_d.candidate: C073-A separate-by-T multinomial logistic, C=0.1, same score-history BASE features

score_support: 28 concrete scorelines with T=0..6 only; both baseline and candidate use identical conditional-renormalized Direct-T probabilities

diagnostic_readout.supportive_if: candidate exact-score LogLoss < baseline, Top1 >= baseline, Top3 >= baseline, and at least 3/4 chronological quartiles have lower exact-score LogLoss
diagnostic_readout.reason: C073-A labels were already opened before this bridge was defined
